full_page.content:
Page 58 Cont. 111
Jane Conklin - 14 - Stammering
July 1
1 Jack Jelenc - 41 - something like stroke and consequent heart trouble .... away from confes. 20 yrs. Enrolled To-night promising confession to-morrow.
2 Hosephine Mrs. Garreau - 51 - Reinhard disease. ... Stroke June 24th .. .husband and two boys. ...
3 Harvey Fisher - 27 - T.B. - Northville. Since last October - sick since August - No hope now but in prayer .... Enrolled before going to Kiefer Hospital. Folks took first book of "City of God" last Friday. They have promised to read all four if boy be spared.
Dolors Krol - 12 - lost hearing at 3 - has forgotten how to talk.
Walter LaCroix - 24 - has been seemingly dissatisfied with wages with life partner etc. Mother worries about them.
Page 59 July 6 Monica Brooks - 15 - brain tuomer has not been able to go to school for some time.
Mrs. Marie Sentes - 37 - threaten with loss of eye ... expecting 8th baby ....
Mrs. Eliz. Marx - 62 - Rhumatic
Mrs. Millicent Schultz ... 64
July 13
John Holme - 51 - partial stroke February .... asks for prayer Lawrence Brancheau - 31 cateracts ... almost blind even from birth Edw'd Duffy - injured shin Mrs. Josephine Whalin - 60 - had operation for lump in side 18 mos. ago .... pains in her arm again
Page 60
Walter "Walters" - 50 - nerveous break-down. .. . went to confession some weeks ago .... comes Today O.K. and happy. This was his Ist con- fession in about 15 yrs. Deo Gr.
